reason: The plugin is primarily a conversation-context utility for DSH that records incremental request deltas, summarizes each unit into ordered one-line recaps, and displays them inline in chat. It also adds configurable recap settings, local storage, an internal recap queue, and helper APIs/tools, with model routing handled through existing DSH LLM provider settings.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH 会话中按每次模型请求自动生成一句话回顾并按顺序插入对话流，支持通过设置页配置生成频率、模型路由与展示行为。
summaries.en: This plugin automatically summarizes each DSH request step into a one-line recap, inserts it in the conversation flow, and provides configurable settings for recap timing, provider/model, and behavior.

capabilities: Captures per-request (turn:step) conversation deltas from session events and summarizes them incrementally.
Maintains per-session recap history in local JSONL storage with retention and compaction controls.
Invokes LLM generation calls via configurable providers/models for recap summaries.
Renders inline recap lines in the conversation UI and provides user settings for cadence and routing.
Exposes /recap/api endpoints for listing, generating, stats, clearing, and settings updates.
Registers agent tools to read recap history and force queue flush

reasons.code: README describes session/event capture, per-session delta handling, queueing, and persistence at ~/.dsh/recap/sessions/<sessionId>.jsonl, including storage limits and compression behavior.
README states summaries are generated via ctx.llm.stream with configurable provider/model and effort fallback behavior, indicating model network/API interaction through routed providers.
README lists POST /recap/api/<method> routes (list, generate, stats, clear, settings, providers), indicating local control APIs available to the client.
README and package metadata show DSH web client integration with inline conversation recap lines and a settings partition in the DSH settings interface.
